description: Local compose stack booted into install mode after a just up image refresh. Root cause chain: install-time config persists at $FABRO_HOME/settings.toml (= /storage/.home/settings.toml inside the fabro-storage volume, Dockerfile ENV FABRO_HOME=/storage/.home); the install-mode bootstrap serves /health 200, so wait-healthy and the Docker healthcheck stay green and only the smoke CLI roundtrip fails. In-repo persistence is correct: the loss requires a fresh volume identity (project rename, down -v, volume rm), not the image refresh itself. Fix: smoke.nu probes GET /install (200 = install mode; configured server removes /install* via removed_web_route in fabro-server/src/server.rs) and prints the recovery step; justfile up header + docker-compose.yaml volume comment document persistence semantics. Nushell gotcha: literal parentheses inside $"..." interpolated strings parse as interpolation expressions — use string concatenation for literal parens.
resolution: documented persistence semantics + smoke.nu install-mode discriminator probe with actionable recovery message (seed fabro-b03f)
